paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness plugin kit: own plugins, version pins, and a repeatable installer
# dsh-kit
这是我的 DeepSeek Harness 插件套装，也是我日常在用的一套。
我把它们整理成了一个可以直接安装的仓库：你在自己的 Harness 上跑一条命令，就能装上我配置的这些插件和版本。想改什么，fork 我这个仓库自己维护，或者只装其中几个。
> 找更多 Harness 插件？GitHub 上搜 `dsh-plugin` 话题。
English
## 这里有什么
**我自己写的这几个**（源码在这个仓库里）：
| 插件 | 做什么 |

| `dsh-connect-grok` | 用你的 xAI 账号登录，把 Grok 模型走 SuperGrok 额度。设置页里登录一次就能用 |
| `desktop-extras` | 一次开三个

Desktop 能力：Git worktree、有头 Playwright 浏览器、桌面控制 |
| `dsh-image-viewer` | 点开对话里的图片和工具截图，缩放、拖动查看 |
| `

harness-eval` | 会话证据面板：一轮活干坏在哪儿、花了多少、重试长什么样 |
| `dsh-turn-autocontinue` | 轮级自动续跑：只在当前轮因模型侧异常中止时续，最多

3 次，每次留痕，到上限就停下并说明原因 |
| `dsh-claude-style-fix` | 去掉侧栏面板列表上方宿主多留的间距，让「新建会话」和下面的行距回到皮肤的 6px |
**我改过的这些**（上游在 npm，我改的地方源码也放进来了，装的是我这份）：
| 插件 | 相对上游改了什么 |
| `dsh-connect-workbuddy` | 中文本地构建（`5.12.4-zh.2`）：固定的中文系统提示、Web GUI 段的中文版、把上游那些会触发网关拒答的英文指纹换成中文；**另外
在提示词正文中段还会被网关拦的那句 harness 说明也换成中文**（11128 的真根因，实测定位到 111 字符）；另加 `retryPolicy` 配置项（默认码表不含 `MALFORMED_
RESPONSE`）。改法与升级流程见 `plugins/dsh-connect-workbuddy/LOCAL-CHANGES.md` |
**别人做的这些**（从 npm 装，清单里锁了版本，我没把源码再拷一份）：
[该节后续省略]
## 装到你的机器上
前提：你已经装好 DeepSeek Harness，`dsh` 能在终端里跑。这个仓库不装 Harness 本身。
[该节后续省略]
## 需要注意的

- **`cordis.patch.yml` 不在这里**。那是你自己的运行时配置，需要的话单独拷
- **WorkBuddy 要自己登录**。形状看 `settings/workbuddy.exam

ple.yml`，填好的别提交
- **版本是照我这台机器锁的**。装到别人机器上，npm 那些是同样的版本，我改过的和自建的（`dsh-connect-workbuddy`、`dsh-image-v
iewer`、`harness-eval` 等）是同一个仓库里的同一份源码，装出来跟我这边一致。升级 WorkBuddy 上游时按 `plugins/dsh-connect-workbuddy/LOC

AL-CHANGES.md` 的流程走，别直接 `dsh plugin add` 覆盖
- **版本是按我这台机器锁的**。你那边 Harness 如果缺某个实验包，会跳过；版本不兼容时 dsh 会拒

绝安装，安装器不会自动做版本豁免——真要装得自己处理
- **`link:` 插件的路径必须前后一致**。profile 的 `package.json` 写绝对 `link:` 时，`pnpm-lo
ck.yaml` 里那条 `version` 也必须是同一个绝对路径。它一旦变成 `link:../../..`，pnpm 按相对层级重建成指向别处的悬空软链接，DSH 启动就报 `cannot re

solve profile bundle`——此时按提示重跑 `dsh plugin install` 没用，会把同一条坏记录再建一遍。要改锁文件里那行 `version`，再重建链接
- **DSH
home 是 junction 时，相对软链接只能活一半**。这是同一个坑更难看见的形态：`~/.dsh` 指向别处（比如 `D:/DSH-Home`）时，profile 有两条路能到——应用按 `
~/.dsh` 启动，pnpm 在真实的盘上装。同盘的 `link:` 目标被 pnpm 写成相对路径（`..\..\..\..\deepseek-harness\plugins\harness-ev
al`），而相对路径是按「用哪条路走到它」解析的：从真实盘走能解开，从 `~/.dsh` 走就悬空。表现是插件列表显示**包不可用 / 包元信息错误**，插件静悄悄地不再加载，但一切看起来都装好了。修

法是把该链接换成绝对 junction：`cmd /c rmdir "<link>"` 再 `cmd /c mklink /J "<link>" "<绝对目标>"`
[该节后续省略]
## What is in here
**Plugins I wrote** (sources live in this repo):
| Plugin | What it does |
| `dsh-connect-grok` | Sign in with your xAI account and route Grok models through your SuperGrok qu

ota. One login in Settings |
| `desktop-extras` | Three Desktop capabilities at once: Git worktrees,

a headed Playwright browser, and native desktop control |
| `dsh-image-viewer` | Open an image or t

ool screenshot from the transcript and zoom, pan around |
| `harness-eval` | Session evidence tab: w

here a run broke down, what it cost, and what the retry looked like |
| `dsh-turn-autocontinue` | Co
ntinues a turn only after an abnormal model-side failure, at most 3 times, records each attempt, the

n stops and says why |
| `dsh-claude-style-fix` | Removes the host gap above the sidebar panel list
so the New Session row keeps the skin's 6px rhythm |
**Plugins I modified** (upstream is on npm; my changed sources are here too, and my copy is what get
odified** (upstream is on npm; my changed sources are here too, and my copy is what gets installed):
| Plugin | What differs from upstream |
| `dsh-connect-workbuddy` | A Chinese local build (`5.12.4-zh.2`): fixed Chinese system prompt, a Ch
inese rendering of the Web GUI paragraph, the upstream English fingerprints that the gateway rejects
replaced with Chinese, and — measured root cause of 11128 — a mid-prompt harness sentence (111 char
acters) replaced with its Chinese equivalent; plus a `retryPolicy` option, since the default retryab
le-code list omits `MALFORMED_RESPONSE`. The changes and the upgrade procedure are in `plugins/dsh-c
onnect-workbuddy/LOCAL-CHANGES.md` |
**Plugins by other people**, installed from npm at the versions I pinned — I do not re-host their so
ins by other people**, installed from npm at the versions I pinned — I do not re-host their sources:
[该节后续省略]
## What is deliberately not here
The whole profile, `node_modules` (one exception: `plugins/dsh-connect-workbuddy/node_modules/@deeps
eek-ai/schemastery`, which is not present at the profile root and would otherwise have to be install
ed separately), lockfiles, WorkBuddy accounts, absolute machine paths, and Harness sources stay out
), lockfiles, WorkBuddy accounts, absolute machine paths, and Harness sources stay out of this repo.
The Harness I run is my fork, Aceared0829/deepseek-harness. Engine changes go there; this repo is on
